note: Manual Featured pins. Highest priority in the Hero: a pin is a human decision and no auto score outranks it. It is empty because nothing has been pinned - an example entry here would be a fabricated editorial choice sitting in production data. The schema is documented in _schema below and in scanner/movie_featured.py.

_schema.id: the catalogue id of a movie or series, exactly as data/movies/<category>/page-*.json or data/series/<category>/index.json spells it
_schema.enabled: false switches the pin off without deleting it
_schema.priority: higher wins; 100 is the conventional top. Equal priorities keep the order they are written in
_schema.start_at: UTC ISO-8601, or null. Before it, the pin is pending and takes no slot
_schema.end_at: UTC ISO-8601, or null. From it, the pin is expired and takes no slot
_schema.note: why it was pinned, for whoever reads this next
_schema.custom_label: OPTIONAL, UI only - a badge word such as EDITOR'S PICK
_schema.custom_kicker: OPTIONAL, UI only - replaces the FEATURED ON CLICK TV line
_schema._forbidden: There is no way to set a title, year, rating, genre or release date here, deliberately. Every fact the Hero shows comes from the catalogue and the metadata cache; a pin chooses WHICH title is shown, never WHAT is said about it.
